title: ObjectCard: redesign cards with rounder corners and a rounded left accent bar
description: Cards now have rounder corners and show their status color as an inset, rounded accent capsule on the left instead of a full-height edge border. The accent color is driven by a new optional borderLeftColor prop on ObjectCard; when it is omitted no accent bar is shown. Migration: cards that previously faked the left border through a custom style passed to ObjectCard's style prop now pass the color via borderLeftColor; the fake-border styles were removed.
